from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingStartRecord(BaseModel):
    """A data row extracted from Table 3a of a housing starts report."""
    statistical_month: str = Field(description="The month the data applies to (YYYY-MM format)")
    report_release_month: str = Field(description="The month the report was released to determine precedence")
    total_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Total housing starts Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate")
    single_family_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Single-family (1 unit) housing starts Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate")
    five_plus_unit_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Buildings with 5 or more units housing starts Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_start_records: list[HousingStartRecord]
